decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The siting, design and appearance, means of access, and materials (Butterley Red Bank Welland Multi Stock brick and Redland Mini Stonewold 36 Tudor Brown tile) for the construction of the development are considered to be acceptable.  The Council is satisfied that the appearance and character of the area would be maintained, in line with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.4.1 Housing Standards and Guidelines, H.4.2 Residential Density, H.6.3 (Back land Development/ Infill Development), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments), and Supplementary Guidance of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The windows formed in the side elevations shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

(Reason.  To prevent overlooking of the nearby premises)
description: Following outline permission (Ref: 01206/B/P3) granted on 15/09/05 for three houses, details pursuant to condition 1, of reserved matters for the siting, design and appearance, and means of access.
